predictions.uncertainty: The 80% interval is deliberately qualitative and wide: zero to three probe survivors is plausible because no prospective contract-complete run exists. The point prediction is frozen at two.

deduplication.fingerprint: normalized causal axis plus normalized subject action contract
deduplication.domainBreadth: A different domain noun does not create novelty.
deduplication.incidentMultiplicity: Exactly one canonical extraction is allowed per source incident.
deduplication.outboxExclusion: Outbox and the repaired WAF are calibration fixtures only and never enter the prospective numerator.

contractCompletion.order: source support, canonical extraction, complete contract, contract gate, semantic deduplication, packet creation
contractCompletion.rule: The engine may draft only from source-supported facts and public domain specifications; a missing obligation is a deficiency, not an invitation to invent behavior.
contractCompletion.stopping: Stop contract drafting after six attempts, even when more source patterns are eligible. Rank source support and structural witness availability before drafting.

readerProtocol.threshold: 2-of-2 promote, with one independent reader from OpenAI and one from Anthropic
packetMustContain: source locator and immutable revision or snapshot digest
readerProtocol.providerFailureRule: If either provider family is unavailable, preserve packets and mark promotion blocked; do not substitute same-provider or self-review.

probeProtocol.eligibility: Only a 2-of-2 cross-provider reader survivor may run.

promotionThresholds.BUILD: At least two B6 probe survivors from independent incidents and at least two causal axes.
promotionThresholds.REPAIR-ENGINE: Zero B6 probe survivors after all eligible cross-provider reviews complete.
promotionThresholds.BLOCKED: Required cross-provider reviews cannot run; this is not equivalent to zero survivors.
